method: Official Fortinet Administration/Configuration/New Features/Release/Architecture documentation drove topic selection. Community sources are not primary lesson sources.

products.selected_feature: route-map-out-preferable and route-map-out6-preferable; normal versus SLA-preferred outbound route-map selection.
Global Database header/footer policy package assignment, ADOM compatibility, include/exclude scope, global objects and metadata-variable resolution.
Explorer quick filters, timeline, related alerts, Details action, triggering logs, handler/rule provenance and incident pivots.
VXLAN VTEP interface, VNI/VLAN mapping, remote IP, static underlay requirements, UDP port and snooping/QoS caveats.
UNII-4 5GHz channels 169/173/177, G-series Single-5G platform mode, Dedicated Scan and radio-3 UNII-5/6 trade-off.
Admin GUI HSTS default enabling in 9.4.5+, 7.2.4+ and 7.4.0+; browser HTTPS enforcement and certificate dependency.
EAP-TLS supported-curve boundary; 7.6.5 GA and later support ECDSA P-384 client certificates.
RADSec accounting request support and client-certificate issuer validation against Local/Trusted CA stores.
SCIM lifecycle management, SAML profile binding, APL role mapping, deprovisioning and immediate session enforcement.
Device and User Risk Scoring from asset criticality, user role/importance, incident severity/frequency and vulnerabilities.
FIDO2/passkey authentication for FortiClient agent tunnels using SAML SSO and Entra ID, with OS-specific prerequisites.
BGP-on-loopback and Dynamic BGP over ADVPN 2.0 shortcuts; direct spoke route exchange without hub route reflection.

access_limitations.direct_open: Most Fortinet Document Library pages returned HTTP 403 when opened directly; indexed official content and page excerpts were used. FortiAP UNII-4 page opened successfully.
access_limitations.mitigation: Retain exact official source URLs and clearly label direct retrieval limitation; do not claim full page fetch where blocked.
